title: The fake FTC picked the wrong grandpa
description:
A fake FTC caller threatens Pops's phone number. Pops spots the setup.
Dramatized from an FTC warning, not a recording. Hang up and report the call.
Sources: FTC, The FTC is not calling to deactivate your phone number
https://consumer.ftc.gov/consumer-alerts/2026/10/ftc-not-calling-deactivate-your-phone-number
Report calls: https://reportfraud.ftc.gov
